# nemau storage export

Download everything in a container.

Every object is fetched through a signed URL, straight from the store: the
100 MiB per-object cap does not apply, and the bytes never cross the API.

The key hierarchy is reproduced on disk. By default a file that is already
present with the right size is skipped, so an export resumes after an
interruption.

## Usage

```
nemau storage export <container> <directory> [flags]
```

## Options

```
      --overwrite       rewrite files that are already present
      --parallel int    number of concurrent downloads (default 4)
      --prefix string   fetch only the keys starting with this prefix
```

## Global options

```
      --api-url string           API origin (default: $NEMAU_API_URL, then https://api.nemau-cloud.com)
      --idempotency-key string   key making a write safe to repeat: 1-128 characters of A-Z a-z 0-9 . _ : - (default: generated)
  -o, --output string            output format: table, json (default "table")
      --project string           target project, by id or by name (default: $NEMAU_PROJECT_ID, then the saved project)
  -q, --quiet                    print ids only
      --timeout duration         how long to wait for one operation (default 30m0s)
      --wait                     wait for asynchronous operations to finish (default true)
```
